source: REQUIRED — provider or photographer (e.g. Getty Images, Adobe Stock, in-house shoot)
source_url: Link to the asset page, contract or shoot folder
license: REQUIRED — licence type, e.g. 'Royalty-free, commercial + editorial'
license_id: REQUIRED — order/asset/contract ID proving the licence
credit: REQUIRED — attribution string to display where the licence requires it
location: Optional — where the photograph was taken
restrictions: Optional — model/property release limits, territory or term limits

provenance_attestation.verified_by: email of the person who verified the licence
provenance_attestation.method: how it was verified, e.g. 'invoice + provider licence certificate on file'
